method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: RA treat-to-target strategy: DAS28, SDAI, CDAI remission thresholds
topic.coverageNote: DAS28 <2.6 is the numeric threshold explicitly used. SDAI and CDAI are named; their numeric cut-offs are not invented.

mcqs.question: What did the studies reviewed here, including a late-RA cohort treated to DAS28 <2.6, show?

options.A: Targeted therapy was superior to conventional care
options.B: Usual care produced higher remission rates
options.C: Targets worsened radiographic outcomes in every study
options.E: Late RA did not benefit from any target

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Targeted therapy was superior to conventional care
mcqs.explanation: Early-RA remission and low-disease-activity targets, and a late-RA comparison of DAS28 <2.6 versus conventional therapy, confirmed that targeted therapy is superior to conventional approaches.

sourceRefs.excerpt: one comparative cohort study addressed treatment to target of DAS28 <2.6 versus conventional therapy in late RA;

mcqs.question: Which measures did participants agree should generally be used to assess disease activity?

options.D: Radiographic Sharp score at every visit

mcqs.explanation: With few exceptions, participants agreed that composite measures, in particular CDAI, DAS, DAS28, or SDAI, should generally be used.

sourceRefs.excerpt: composite measures, in particular Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI), DAS, DAS28 or Simplified Disease Activity Index (SDAI),

mcqs.question: What disagreement remained about remission definitions?

options.A: Some would not dismiss DAS or DAS28 remission; others preferred Boolean or SDAI-based ACR/EULAR remission
options.E: Remission was removed as a target

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Some would not dismiss DAS or DAS28 remission; others preferred Boolean or SDAI-based ACR/EULAR remission
mcqs.explanation: Some participants would not dismiss DAS and DAS28 remission, while others wanted the Boolean or SDAI-based definition used.

sourceRefs.excerpt: one should not dismiss DAS and DAS28 remission, while others were of the opinion that the new definition of remission (Boolean or SDAI-based) should be used

mcqs.question: Which practical remission definitions does the update say were also presented, not only trial definitions?

options.A: Boolean criteria without CRP, and CDAI remission
options.E: Steroid-free status regardless of joint counts

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Boolean criteria without CRP, and CDAI remission
mcqs.explanation: The task force notes that Boolean criteria without CRP and CDAI remission criteria had been presented for clinical practice as well as trials.

sourceRefs.excerpt: also remission definitions for clinical practice (Boolean criteria without C-reactive protein (CRP) and CDAI remission criteria) had been presented

mcqs.question: Two studies compared a clinical target with sonographic remission. What outcome does the update report?

options.D: Ultrasound was required to show any benefit of treat-to-target

mcqs.explanation: Two studies comparing treatment aimed at good clinical outcomes versus sonographic remission showed similar outcomes.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Two studies compared treatment approaches targeting good clinical outcomes versus sonographic remission, showing similar outcomes.
